title: Single-name move screen 2026-11-05 (router-gated): 138 passed, index-only while B is gated
body_md:
D1 2026-11-05 single-name move screen, ROUTER-GATED MODE (Strategy B DO-NOT-ACTIVATE). Population: US-listed common stocks (incl. ADSs/LP units) with market cap >= $2B and |close-to-close| >= 5% on 2026-11-05 against 2026-11-04. Discovery: key-less Nasdaq screener + per-symbol quote/info closes dated Nov 5 measured 1993 names; 591 cleared 5% on that basis on a broad DOWN day (discovery median -2.7%). Event identity from the Nasdaq earnings calendar (schedule only) and one scripted EDGAR submissions batch; no metered call.

IBKR confirmation (figure of record) is complete for every reaction-window name with an explaining own-event filing: 140 names were measured on regular-session daily bars (88 in the first pass, the remaining 52 in a paced second pass) and 138 pass (>= 5% with a stamped own-event filing in the reaction window); 2 measured below 5% on IBKR (CMI -4.93%, JOBY +4.95%). Other rejected names (452 compact tuples): ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED 196, DAY2_EVENT_PRIOR 214, POST_MOVE_EVENT 42. Compact closes are Nasdaq discovery closes.

Filing text was read for all non-2.02 window filings: non-explaining ones (buy-backs, dividends, notes offerings, presentations, monthly metrics, a completed earlier deal, ADS redomiciliation artifact CDLR) went to ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED. No deal-pinned target found.

Close-chain: 22 forward-chain hits against the landed 2026-11-04 row, all names coded POST_MOVE_EVENT there (filing after the 11-04 close) that now pass with an after-close 2026-11-04 anchor; legitimate, recorded in each reason. Degraded legs are in fields.degraded_legs.

fields.legacy_rule: move >= 5% close-to-close (Strategy B frozen Entry criterion 1; mechanical record-only benchmark; legacy_rule_pass=true on every item here)
fields.selection_rule: Symbol list and marketCap from the key-less Nasdaq screener (its pctchange lags and was not used): 2135 rows with marketCap >= $2B, of which 130 non-common lines (preferreds, notes, bonds, warrants, depositary-interest lines) were excluded; 2005 symbols were fetched on api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/<SYM>/info and 1993 carried a regular-session close dated 'Closed at Nov 5, 2026' (prior close = close minus netChange; discovery only); 12 further non-common/fund/tracking-class lines (closed-end funds, baby bond, trust preferred, preferred-share ADS) were dropped, leaving 1993 measured names, 591 of them >=5% on that basis. Names with >=4.5% were labelled from the key-less Nasdaq earnings calendar (schedule only) and one scripted EDGAR data.sec.gov/submissions batch (form, items 1.01/2.02/4.02/7.01/8.01 or 6-K, acceptanceDateTime; reaction window = accepted after 2026-11-04 21:00Z to 2026-11-05 21:00Z; after-close = before 05:00Z 11-05, anchor 2026-11-04; pre-open 05:00Z-14:30Z and intraday to 21:00Z anchor 2026-11-05); no Tavily, web_search, WebFetch or FMP call was made. Filing text was read for every in-window filing that is not an Item 2.02 earnings 8-K; filings that do not explain the move went to ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED. Layer 2 measured on IBKR regular-session daily bars (close array, ONE_DAY, outside_rth=false, 13-22 bars; search_contracts paced under its 30/min limit) 140 names so far; 0 reaction-window names remain IBKR_UNMEASURED because the IBKR leg could not be completed within this run's budget (see degraded_legs), and no name is passed without an IBKR measurement. prior_qualifying_* counts other >=5% IBKR close-to-close sessions in the 10 sessions 2026-10-22..2026-11-04; conviction ladder: >=3 prior => 30, 2 prior => 45, else |move|>=15 => 75, >=10 => 60, else 45. Source limit: free primary sources only (router-gated), so a name with no own filing in the window is ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED.
